summary: Iteration 3 — IA Match v3 freemium + theming + real LLM. Backend: 33/33 pytest passed (8 new v3 + 25 regression). Frontend: catalogue 48 cards OK; theme toggle changes background (light cream rgb(253,251,247) ↔ dark navy rgb(14,17,24)) across all tabs; freemium paywall blocks Academy/Builder/Compare/Benchmarks; activating premium unlocks Builder which calls Claude Haiku 4.5 successfully (real LLM output ≈ 130 chars returned in <15s); news featured navigates to /news/n1 with full markdown article; tool detail exposes tool-logo-link + tool-visit-website; Profile shows 12 resources r1–r12.

issues: Persistent React Native Web deprecation warnings still present in Expo logs ('shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only, carried over from iter1/iter2.

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/builder/run integrates emergentintegrations.LlmChat with Claude Haiku 4.5 (anthropic provider). End-to-end real call returns valid French output. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY read from env.
GET /api/news returns 7 articles with new fields intro/body/author. n1 body contains markdown '## ...' headers as required.
GET /api/tools returns 48 items each with new `domain` field; Clearbit image URL derived from domain (cross-checked).
GET /api/resources returns 12 items grouped across YOUTUBE/BLOG/PODCAST/NEWSLETTER/OUTIL with valid URLs.

Premium gate verified end-to-end: free user → /compare, /benchmarks, Academy tab, Builder tab all render PremiumGate (testID premium-activate). Tapping profile-toggle-premium unlocks all four sections (Builder fields role/objective/run + run produces output via testID builder-output).

Theme toggle persisted via AsyncStorage works: switching from Profile tab repaints all tabs — Catalogue surface goes from rgb(253,251,247) to rgb(14,17,24); confirmed visually (screenshot dark catalogue).

Tool detail (/tool/chatgpt) renders both tool-logo-link (logo tile) and tool-visit-website ('Visiter openai.com') testIDs. Pressables use Linking.openURL on tap; no anchor href on web — expected for RN Pressable.
News featured (testID news-featured) navigates correctly to /news/n1 and renders the full article body.
seed_data_creation: Builder LLM session id stored client-side only; 1 TEST_pytest rating row in db.ratings (regression).
